scripts.dev: bun run train && bun run --parallel --filter "*" dev
scripts.build: bun run train && bun run build:apps
scripts.typecheck: bun run train && tsc --noEmit && bun run --filter "*" typecheck
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run train && bun run check:prepared
scripts.train: bun run build:packages && bun run train:filters && bun run train:neural
scripts.build:packages: bun run build:core && bun run --filter @matchbox-ai/train build && bun run --filter @matchbox-ai/cli build
scripts.train:neural: bun run matchbox train examples/is-even && bun run matchbox train examples/money && bun run matchbox train tests/fixtures/field-classifier
scripts.check:prepared: tsc --noEmit && bun run --filter "*" typecheck && bun test ./tests && bun run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: bun run --filter @matchbox-ai/playground build && bun run --filter @matchbox-ai/benchmarks build
